<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 20:7">Targ. O. Ex. XX, 7</cite> (h. text <he>שוא</he>). Targ. ib. 13; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 104a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>קושטא קאי ש׳ וכ׳</he> truth stands firm, falsehood does not.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 82a">B. Bath. 82ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מחזי כש׳</he> it looks like a lie.
